name: ASML

source.quote: ASML reported another record year in 2025, with total net sales of €32.7 billion and a gross margin of 52.8%.

description: Dutch maker of lithography machines, the only supplier of the EUV tools needed to make the most advanced chips.
explain: Every leading-edge chip factory (TSMC, Samsung, Intel, SK hynix) must buy ASML's EUV machines, which cost hundreds of millions of dollars each. Revenue is €32.7 billion for 2025, converted by AI Atlas at about $1.13 per euro (approximate 2025 average).
